chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام.
That 'Ali عليه السلام found a man and a woman under a single cover, so he struck each one of them with one hundred lashes, except for one lash.

key_terms.فَضَرَبَ: so he struck; administered corporal punishment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam 'Ali عليه السلام rule when a man and a woman were found under one cover?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial action of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام concerning a man and a woman found together under one cover. It is used in the context of legal discussions on hadd-related punishments and improper seclusion or intimate circumstances short of proven zina.
